reuse.why: Computes expectedAmount with the existing shared getScheduledAmount, which already handles missing, single and ranged amounts for the other consumers.

duplication.why: No amount logic is re-implemented; the new field is a single call to the shared helper.

placement.why: The derived field is added in the api/schedules-get handler with a dedicated APIScheduleListEntity type, keeping scheduleModel.toExternal (also used for round-tripping) unchanged; putting it in api-models as a list mapper would have been marginally more consistent.

scope.why: Only the list handler, its result type and a test are touched.

maintainability.why: Any future change to the expected-amount rule in getScheduledAmount flows to the API automatically, and the type makes the extra field explicit.
